name: Jenkins - Script Console Command Execution
description: The Jenkins Groovy script console (/script) runs code as the Jenkins user. This Groovy snippet executes an OS command and prints its output - instant RCE with admin (or misconfigured anonymous) access.

defense.why_it_works: Jenkins' Script Console (/script) executes arbitrary Groovy code server-side as the Jenkins process user. Admin users can run system commands via Runtime.exec() -- Groovy has full JVM access with no sandboxing.
defense.prerequisites: Valid Jenkins admin credentials (or anonymous access if security disabled). Network access to Jenkins web interface.
defense.impact: Full RCE as Jenkins OS user. Access to all Jenkins credentials (build secrets, SSH keys, API tokens). Lateral movement to any system Jenkins reaches (often large CI/CD infrastructure).
defense.detection: POST requests to /script endpoint. Jenkins audit log (Audit Trail plugin) showing script execution. Unusual child processes spawned from Jenkins (bash, cmd). Network connection from Jenkins to attacker IP.
defense.artifacts: Jenkins access log (POST /script) | Audit Trail log (Groovy script execution) | Process audit log (bash spawned from java) | Jenkins credentials access log
defense.splunk_spl:
index=sysmon EventCode=1 (ParentImage="*w3wp.exe" OR ParentImage="*httpd*" OR ParentImage="*apache*" OR ParentImage="*php-cgi*" OR ParentImage="*php-fpm*" OR ParentImage="*java.exe" OR ParentImage="*tomcat*")
| where match(Image, "(?i)(cmd|powershell|bash|sh|nc|python)")
| table _time, Computer, ParentImage, Image, CommandLine

index=web sourcetype=access_combined (method=POST OR status=500)
| stats count by clientip, uri_path | where count>3
defense.elastic_kql: event.code:"1" AND process.parent.name:(w3wp.exe OR httpd OR apache2 OR php-fpm OR java.exe) AND process.name:(cmd.exe OR powershell.exe OR bash OR sh OR nc OR python*)
defense.sentinel_kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","httpd","apache2","php-fpm","php-cgi","java.exe","nginx")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","bash","sh","nc","python")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine
| sort by Timestamp desc
// Jenkins /script console RCE - java.exe spawning a shell
defense.prevention: Use Matrix Authorization Strategy to grant Script Console access only to super-admins. Require 2FA for all Jenkins accounts. Monitor /script endpoint and alert on any POST.
defense.misconfiguration: Jenkins Script Console accessible to all admin users. No granular RBAC for script execution. No audit logging of script executions.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Jenkins default
# /script accessible to all admin users
# No additional authorization check for Groovy execution
defense.secure_config:
# Matrix Authorization Strategy plugin
# Grant Overall/RunScripts to super-admin only
# Or restrict Jenkins behind VPN entirely
# Audit Trail plugin: log all /script POSTs
defense.evasion: Route through a legitimate Jenkins build job shell step -- avoids /script endpoint detection.

explain:
Runs an OS command from the Jenkins Groovy script console (/script):
  def cmd = '<command>'          the command to execute
  def proc = cmd.execute()       run it
  consumeProcessOutput(sout,serr) + waitForOrKill   capture stdout/stderr
  println sout                   print the result
Executes as the Jenkins user - instant RCE with admin (or misconfigured anonymous) access to the console; escalate from there to a full reverse shell.
